Package edu.bu.pas.hex

Interface GenericGame

All Known Implementing Classes:
Game, GameView
public interface GenericGame
A class representing an arbitrary turn-based static game. Instances are either mutable or immutable depending on what kind of access privileges you want Agent instances to have. This is important to protected the original instance of the game (whose game logic is being executed) from Agents trying to attack it (like arbitrarily marking that they won the game or something).

Instances also contain the Agents who are playing the game. To prevent Agents from attacking each other, the only instance who keeps the Agents is the original instance whose game logic is being executed. All copies (immutable or mutable) of this original instance will not contain copied Agents, instead they will have their Agents set to null.

  • Method Details

    • getNumPlayers

      int getNumPlayers()
      A method to get the number of players in this game. Each Agent is given an index corresponding to which player in the game that Agent is. The set of player indices will range from 0 to getNumPlayer()-1.
      Returns:
      The number of players in this game.

    • getNumActions

      int getNumActions()
      A method to get the number of legal Actions the current player has in this game. This method is supposed to be optimized so that calling this function is much cheaper than calling getActions().size().
      Returns:
      The number of legal Actions the current player has in this game.

    • getActions

      Collection<Action> getActions()
      A method to eagerly calculate all the Actions the current player can make in this game. Call this if you want to build this collection eagerly otherwise call getActionIterator to get a lazy iterator over the Actions. If you just want to get the number of legal actions see getNumActions which is supposed to be much faster than getting that number as the size of the output collection from this method.
      Returns:
      The eagerly-computed collection of legal Actions the current player has in this game.

    • getActionIterator

      Iterator<Action> getActionIterator()
      A method to lazily calculate all the Actions the current player can make in this game. Call this if you care about getting an Action as soon as possible and deferring the computation for other Actions to further traversal of the Iterator.
      Returns:
      The lazily-computed collection of legal Actions the current player has in the game.

    • getCurrentAgentAction

      Action getCurrentAgentAction() throws NoAgentException
      A method to get a single Action from the Agent who is currently going in this turn. This will throw an exception if there are no Agent instances stored inside this game.
      Returns:
      The Action chosen by the current Agent.
      Throws:
      NoAgentException

    • apply

      GenericGame apply(Action action) throws Exception
      A method to apply an Action to this game. This is designed with the intention that this instance is not mutable, so first a mutable copy will be built, mutated, made immutable, and then returned.
      Parameters:
      action - The Action to apply
      Returns:
      The immutable instance containing the result of applying the Action to this instance.
      Throws:
      Exception

    • isOver

      boolean isOver()
      A method to check whether this game is over or not.
      Returns:
      true if this game is over and false otherwise.

    • isMutable

      boolean isMutable()
      A method to test whether this instance is mutable or not. If this instance is mutable, some operations defined but sub-classes of this type will function differently than if this instance is immutable.
      Returns:
      true if this instance is mutable and false otherwise.

    • getMutableInstance

      GenericGame getMutableInstance()
      A method to build a mutable copy of this instance. Importantly any Agent stored in this instance will not be copied over and will be set to null.
      Returns:
      A mutable copy of this instance where internal Agents are set to null.

    • getMutableInstance

      GenericGame getMutableInstance(Agent... agents) throws Exception
      A method to build a mutable copy of this instance and set the Agents of that mutable copy to be the provided Agent instances. The number of Agents provided must be the same as the number of players in the game, and the Agents must be listed in their player order (e.g. the first Agent will correspond to player 0, the second to player 1, etc.).
      Parameters:
      agents - The Agents to be stored in the mutable copy.
      Returns:
      A mutable copy of this instance where internal Agents are provided.
      Throws:
      Exception

    • playUntilCompletion

      GenericGame playUntilCompletion() throws Exception
      A method to play the game until completion using the Agents stored inside this instance. If these are null a NullPointerException will be raised and if any Agent throws an exception that exception will be thrown here.
      Returns:
      An instance of the completed game.
      Throws:
      Exception

    • getTerminalUtility

      Double getTerminalUtility(int playerIdx)
      A method to get the terminal utility for the provided player. This method will return null if this is not a terminal instance.
      Parameters:
      playerIdx - The index of the player to get the terminal utility for.
      Returns:
      The value of the terminal utility if the game is terminal otherwise null.
